0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-2, 0-1 at home, 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 2-0 overall streak, 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West) in the third game of the Kings' season. Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Keegan Murray (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; Memphis is missing Zach Edey (ankle), and Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Kings won the last meeting 123-114 in Memphis on February 23, 2026, though they lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, and the two teams have not yet played each other this season.
